WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds AS BytesPerMs
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0
),
per_type AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeName, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMs
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY MediaTypeName
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS DiffFromOverall
FROM per_type p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg;
